sourceFile: 29. MSU-L20S15-07 Report test New Dry UV Machine 395nm ( Normal 365nm) date 2.05.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a usable validation report but misstates the change factor and uses unreliable LED UV grouping.
issues: Changed factor is filename, not actual 365nm vs 395nm dry UV change.
Baseline and test conditions are marked unclear despite explicit normal/test rows.
LED UV outcomes cite headers and aggregate mixed rows instead of data rows.
Subgroup keys for sheet/product, line, film condition, and tension spec are missing.
Judgements and violation counts for LED UV appear unsupported.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to new dry UV 395nm versus normal dry UV 365nm.
Add subgroup keys for sheet/product, line, film use, VP film, and tension spec.
Rebuild LED UV outcomes from rows 22, 24, 30, and 32 per sheet.
Keep tension outcomes by sheet with rows 39, 43, 45, and decision row 50.
Remove unsupported spec and violation calculations unless directly evidenced.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are insufficient; final evidence must cite explicit condition and data rows.
